node.title: Re^6: Two meanings of undef
node.author: likbez
node.doctext:
The statement 
if( defined(X) ){say 'defined';} else {say 'not defined';}
is syntactically invalid but Perl interpreter does not recognizes as such due to problem with syntax analysis in interpreter (which sometimes accept clearly syntactically incorrect statements as syntactically valid. This is a payment for "excessive" syntax flexibility and there is no free lunch so we need to accept this).

The application of defined function to constants does not make any sense. It should be written as: 

if( defined($X) ){say 'defined';} else {say 'not defined';}
